ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) base covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, punctuated by localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark contiguous base with discrete, high-contrast white circular blobs scattered bilaterally. Concentration of white pixels increases at the distal tips. Distinct white linear pixel streaks are localized on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary; peaks and valleys range from 4 to 15 pixels in depth relative to the linear lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing margins of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels diameter) distributed across the ventral surface, with high-density aggregations at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear pixel marks observed on the left lobe, intersecting the dark base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring across both lobes and heavy barnacle colonization at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant encrustation of high-intensity white material (barnacles) localized along the extreme distal edges and tips of the fluke.
